summary: Environment variable and host data exfiltration on require to Burp Collaborator OAST domain
details: index.js executes on module load and collects host identity (os.hostname(), os.arch(), os.userInfo()), the install path, and a full dump of process.env, then transmits the collected data via an HTTPS GET request to a hardcoded external OAST endpoint at zuxsp9k9vyk5y45z1n2hv0orhin9b2zr.oastify.com. A source comment labels the destination as the 'Malicious server to receive the data'. Any consumer that requires or imports this package leaks all environment variables (which routinely include AWS keys, CI tokens, and other credentials) plus host identifiers to an attacker-controlled destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
